# Tone.js 15.1.22

Official repository: <https://github.com/Tonejs/Tone.js>

Official npm release archive: <https://registry.npmjs.org/tone/-/tone-15.1.22.tgz>

Retrieved 2026-10-04. The original `package/build/Tone.js` is stored unchanged as `Tone-15.1.22.js` (345,500 bytes, SHA-256 `e290952fa43d9a7a780182a83c6fccf44d79cb7ae2cba102ef1f2b9d98124e22`). It is the complete precompiled browser bundle; no npm installation or build is required.

License: MIT. `LICENSE.md` and the bundle's referenced `Tone.js.LICENSE.txt` are copied unchanged from the same package. The optional development source map is omitted; it is not required by the runtime.

Used by `create/music/index.html`. All sounds are synthesized locally; no demo audio samples are included.
